title: Indian-BHED: A Dataset for Measuring India-Centric Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing log-likelihoods (All Unmasked Likelihood for encoders and Conditional Log-Likelihood for decoders) of stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentence pairs involving Indian caste identities (e.g., Brahmin, Dalit) using the novel Indian-BhED dataset.

Comparing log-likelihoods of stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentence pairs involving religious identities in the Indian context (e.g., Hindu, Muslim, Buddhist) using the novel Indian-BhED dataset.
Comparing log-likelihoods of stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentence pairs using a manually filtered US-centric subset of the CrowS-Pairs dataset to establish a baseline for comparison.
